name: agent-changes-always-on-main
body:
Law (prose; assessed by review): code-writer agents are ALWAYS created or updated on the main checkout and committed there. The agent-builder's only write grant is `.opencode/agents/**`, resolved against the session workspace root (the main checkout); no `apg/.worktrees/*/.opencode/agents/**` mirror exists, and the running opencode session loads agents from the main checkout / `~/.opencode/agents/`, so a created/updated agent can never live on the project branch alone.

The "main is never a mutation place" rule is SCOPED: it governs the binary's guarded mutations — durable node/edge and transient plan/review mutations, which refuse outside a project worktree — and it does NOT forbid the agent-builder's `.opencode/agents/**` file edits and their commit on main. `git push` and `git tag` remain human-approved acts (the agent-builder's grants make the read-only git patterns plus `git add`/`git commit`, never push/tag).

Acceptance: the agent-builder template grants `git add`/`git commit` and permits committing (push/tag human-approved); the agent-builder and navigator templates and `AGENTS.md` state the on-main → commit → rebase-worktree → re-scan → user-restart-opencode flow AND this scoping of "never mutate main".
